Dialogue.Line: It's just an ordinary crate.
It doesn't look like it's been touched in a while.
I need to go somewhere else.
The shelves are lined with weathered tomes. Most have not been touched in years.
Dust clings to every volume. Whatever knowledge these books hold has long been forgotten.
A stone statue of Lunaria watches silently over the courtyard.
Time has worn away many of its details, but its gentle expression remains.
A large telescope is positioned beneath the observatory dome.
Its lenses are clouded with dust, as though no one has looked to the stars in ages.
Splintered crates lie buried beneath fallen stone from the collapsed east wing.
Only fragments of the bookshelf remain, crushed beneath the rubble.
The fountain has long since frozen over. Not even the faintest trickle of water remains.
The clock tower stands untouched beneath layers of snow.
None seems to have echoed through this place for a very long time.
...Hmm? Something wandered in. A wolf?
Oh! It seems to be injured...
Hang on... I'll help you.
You're awake...
Your wound isn't serious, but I don't have everything I need here.
I'll be right back to get some supplies to treat it.
Stay here, alright? Don't wander off.
Wait... where did the wolf go?
...You—were you the wolf from earlier?
That's impossible... but the wound... it's the same.
So you really are the same...
I've read about creatures that can change form, but I never thought I'd see one myself.
Don't worry. You're safe here. I won't tell anyone.
You look a little lost... Do you remember anything about where you came from?
…I see. Well, you’re currently in the Pale Snowfields. This place is known for its universities and research halls.
There are several regions beyond the snowfields.
To the south are the Springtide Meadows. It used to be a flourishing place where most of the food and crops were grown.
To the west lies the Mirage Plains, where craft guilds and smiths once forged tools, armor, and machinery.
And to the east is the Amberwood Forest, where trade routes and markets once connected people from different lands.
These places used to thrive… but things haven’t been the same for a long time.
There's an old legend everyone learns growing up….
If you're looking for answers, exploring the lands beyond the snowfields might help.
Take this map. It should help you find your way.
If you head south, you'll eventually reach the Springtide Meadows.
Obtained Map Item.
You should be on your way now, and make sure to take care, alright?
Traveler, you made it. The road into Moonveil isn't an easy one.
You're safe here. Feel free to stay longer to rest.
Though I suppose rest isn't what brought you here.
...I'm looking for answers.
If you intend to travel further, make your way to Springtide Meadows.
It's a quiet farming settlement south of here. The people there have begun seeing strange changes in the land. Nothing they can explain.
Changes?
Crops and fields blooming out of season, animals abandoning places they've called home for generations.
Many dismiss them as unfortunate coincidences, however.
Do you?
I believe the land speaks before disaster arrives... although very few listened to learn.
She seems lost in thought, staring.
Is something the matter?
...No, forgive me. For a moment, you seemed very familiar.
A gentle presence, yet carrying a sorrow I cannot place.
Perhaps it's only my imagination.
Pay an old wanderer's thoughts no mind. It must be my age.
May your journey serve you well.
Ah, that's the community board.
People from across the regions leave requests there whenever they need an extra pair of hands.
If your journey allows for it, consider lending them your aid.
I should speak with the guide before leaving Moonveil.
I should finish what I came here to do before heading that way.
